title: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword
shortDescription: An aerial fantasy adventure that uses deliberate swordplay and puzzle-heavy dungeons to give its journeys a hands-on rhythm.
highlights: Enemy encounters reward reading angles and timing
Dungeons build satisfying chains of spatial and tool-based puzzles
keywords: The Legend of Zelda: Skyward Sword

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A Wii adventure recommendation for its considered dungeon design and distinctive use of the platform's controls.
